blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senators on Friday questioned whether the proposed P175.04-billion budget of the Department of Agriculture (DA) for 2027 would be enough to address the expected impact of Super El Niño on farmers and fisherfolk. During the plenary deliberations on the proposed 2027 national budget, Sens. Risa Hontiveros and Erwin Tulfo raised concerns over the department’s reduced allocation despite the looming weather phenomenon. Under the Senate committee report on the 2027 General Appropriations Bill, the DA’s proposed budget was set at P175.04 billion, lower than the P182.47-billion allocation under the House-approved version.
